module: "Linked Set" layer type of the Dynamic Decals tool: behaves like a group, but you can add to it in the inspector properties (among api.properties) with a value. The "Apply" button recursively propagates these values to all child layers that have the property, whatever their type. The toolbar button (order 40) calls api.addLinkedSet.
notes: Only children that already have a non-nil `property.id` field are modified.
Special case decalGradientColor: a four-value property is spread over decalGradientColorTopLeft / TopRight / BottomLeft / BottomRight.
Special case useSurfaceNormal: the child's decalPos and decalNorm are set to nil to force recomputation of the decal matrix (the code calls it a hack).
Property types not handled by setProperty print "not yet implemented" in the console.
layer.propertiesDirty becomes true on each modification; the inspector then displays a message asking to click "Apply".
The delete button of a property does not mark propertiesDirty nor call api.setLayer.

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets the related modules, registers the inspector GUI of the linkedSet type, the "linkedSet" toolbar item and the "Layer Types / Linked Set Layers" documentation page.
